description: Draw an accurate birth (natal) chart: Sun, Moon and rising sign, every planet with sign, degree and house, the angles and the tightest aspects. Works without a birth time (then no rising sign or houses). Returns a link to the person's sky in 3D on Pluto Garden and guide pages for each placement. Pass the place as the person said it; the server looks it up. Convert the time to 24-hour local time at the birth place.

latitude.description: Optional. Latitude of the birth place, if already known; skips the place search.

longitude.description: Optional. Longitude of the birth place, if already known.

place.description: Birth place: town or city, with region or country if known, e.g. "Leeds, England".

time.description: Birth time as 24-hour HH:mm local clock time at the birth place, e.g. "15:20". Omit if unknown.

name: birth_chart
title: Birth chart
